title: GovLens
tagline: Real-time governance analytics for stronger DAOs. Track voter turnout, proposal success, and more.
description:
GovLens is a platform designed to provide a comprehensive governance health score and insights into the performance of Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs). By aggregating and analyzing critical governance data, GovLens empowers DAO members, leaders, and stakeholders to make informed decisions.

Core Functionalities:

Real-time Metrics: GovLens tracks key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Token Holders, Total Trades of DAO Token, Airdrop Tables, DAO Token Transfers, and many more. 
Data Visualization: The platform presents complex data in easy-to-understand visualizations, such as charts, graphs, and dashboards, to help users quickly identify trends and patterns. 

Benefits:

Improved Decision Making: Data-driven insights help DAO leaders make informed decisions about resource allocation, governance structure, and community building.
Enhanced Transparency: GovLens promotes transparency by providing clear and accessible information about DAO performance.
Increased Community Engagement: By tracking community participation and sentiment, GovLens helps DAOs identify areas for improvement and foster a more engaged community.
Risk Mitigation: By monitoring key metrics, GovLens can help DAOs identify potential risks and take proactive measures to mitigate them.

Target Audience
DAO Leaders: To make data-driven decisions and optimize governance processes.
DAO Members: To gain insights into their DAO's performance and participate more effectively.
Investors: To assess the health and potential of DAOs.
Researchers: To study DAO governance models and trends.
how_its_made:
GovLens is a product of extensive research into DAO governance metrics and a deep commitment to user experience. Our development process centered around creating an impactful and user-friendly platform. It is powered by real-time data from blockchain infrastructure providers like @Goldsky and transaction insights from explorers such as @Blockscout, offers a comprehensive governance health score for Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs).

Currently we have implemented it for Optimism DAO and in future we will be adding more DAOs.

Technology Stack
To bring GovLens to life, we leveraged the following technologies:

Frontend: Next.js for building a dynamic and interactive user interface.
Blockchain Integration: 
Goldsky: For real-time data streaming.
Blockscout: For Block explorer and analyze transaction data.
Data Visualization: Libraries like chart.js, react-chartjs-2 & recharts for creating engaging data visualizations.
